about: An open source inventory system for electronic parts, run on your own server.

prs.title: Parts exported from Part-DB import back in
prs.broken: Importing a parts file that Part-DB had exported itself failed with a server error when a supplier had no shipping cost, and nothing was imported.
prs.changed: An empty number cell in an import file is now read as no value instead of crashing.
prs.matters: People can move or restore their parts list with Part-DB's own export and import.
